# Bac Apple Binary Instrumentation Toolkit — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Systems programming toolkit for Apple Silicon ARM64 Mach-O binary parsing, memory page telemetry, symbol table extraction, and dynamic binary inspection.

## Project Identification
- Name: Bac Apple (bac_apple)
- Creator: Jirnyak (https://github.com/Jirnyak)
- Co-Architect & Contributor: Adolf Petushkov (https://github.com/marko1olo)
- Live Showcase: https://jirnyak.github.io/bac_apple/
